extension.summary: Channels DVR Hub: Dashboard, guide, recordings and passes for Kodi
extension.description: Channels DVR Hub is an ALPHA client for Kodi 21 Omega. It connects to a configured Channels DVR and provides a Dashboard, full-screen Guide, Recordings, DVR management, Search and Settings. Search covers bounded loaded listings. Playback uses Kodi with full-screen as the default and optional background browsing. Live tuning requires explicit confirmation. Scheduling and supported pass actions use separate review and provider readback.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial ALPHA add-on for Kodi 21 Omega only. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Channels or Fancy Bits, LLC. Project support: https://github.com/kcook98765/script.channelsdvr.hub/issues . Playback, scheduling, pass management and connected DVR behavior have not been natively accepted for this release. Use only your own authorized DVR and content with the required subscription and server build. Channels DVR may use another available source. Preview matches do not guarantee future coverage. Saved rules stay on the DVR after you exit Kodi. Private operation history is retained; no automatic changes or retries.
extension.news: 0.2.0 ALPHA owner-review candidate: Modernized Hub navigation, full-screen Guide, recording categories, unified DVR and Search, startup and browsing preferences, and native playback presentation options. Real live TV acceptance and compact Now Playing controls remain pending.
